subject: Temporary lock and staggered integration for Hydra-v1.2
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary lock and staggered integration for Hydra-v1.2

Team —

Hydra just handed back their v1.2 variant artifacts this morning. Engineering reports a handful of tokenizer/byte-split divergences and a KV-cache shape edge-case when sequence length > 4096. Given the downstream inference impact, I want to propose a temporary integration lock for the full fleet while we run a staggered ingress (canary -> limited -> ramp) with the following asks:

- Marcus: can infra stage a limited-canary (10% capacity) and enforce a seq-max of 4096 at the ingress layer?
- Laura: can you draft a short rollback playbook (2 pages) and owner list for the canary window?
- Kimberly & Naomi: we need a compatibility matrix (tokenizer mapping, expected token growth, perf delta) to share with Hydra and CS. Naomi, please include telemetry signal names.

Hydra is on standby for a short integration window but asked for a firm date range; I'd like to give them a 7–10 day window after we validate. I prefer a temporary lock (no fleetwide promotion) until the matrix is green and we've exercised the rollback.

Attachments: hydra-v1.2-compat-matrix.csv (placeholder) and staging-rollout-plan-v2.docx (outline).

Thanks — please reply with ETA on the bullets.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary lock and staggered integration for Hydra-v1.2

Jasmine —

We can stand up a limited canary with the seq-max enforcement at the gateway level. Quick notes:

- ETA: canary cluster provisioned by Mon 10/4 EOD (need approval on quota).
- Seq-max enforcement will be a soft reject (422) for now — ops prefers soft fail to capture telemetry and avoid client-side crashes.
- We'll add a roll-forward knob to bypass the lock if Hydra supplies an alternate tokenizer mapping within 48 hours.

Questions:
1) Do we want to surface a user-visible error message for requests >4096 or silently truncate at gateway?
2) For the 10% canary, do we route based on region or top-k customers? I recommend top-k (surgically choose non-critical internal customers) to minimize blast radius.

I'll start the provisioning once Laura confirms the rollback playbook and we have a signed-canary window.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Claire D'Souza <claire@hydrasys.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary lock and staggered integration for Hydra-v1.2

Thanks for the heads up, Jasmine and Marcus —

We can provide an updated tokenizer map by Tue 10/5 but want the canary window to start no earlier than Thu 10/7 to give our QA time. We appreciate the soft-reject approach so we can capture failing inputs. A couple asks from our side:

- Please include the exact telemetry signal names so our engineers can correlate errors on our side.
- We'll need a short SLA exception for the canary (no fleet promotion without Hydra sign-off).

If you want, we can join a 30-minute sync Mon afternoon to align on rollback steps.

Best,
Claire D'Souza
Principal Engineer, Hydra Systems
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary lock and staggered integration for Hydra-v1.2

All —

Draft rollback playbook (high level) — attached as staging-rollout-plan-v2.docx. Key items:

1) Canary abort criteria (15% error spike or >5% higher median latency sustained for 10 minutes).
2) Immediate steps on abort: remove Hydra-v1.2 from canary route, point canary to previous variant, revoke any staged autoscaling policies.
3) Post-abort postmortem cadence: 72-hour incident review with Hydra, infra, and product reps.

I've also added a runbook snippet for manual KV cache flush on nodes where we see shape mismatches. Marcus — need your confirmation on the flush command (I put a placeholder).

Attachments: staging-rollout-plan-v2.docx

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire D'Souza <claire@hydrasys.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary lock and staggered integration for Hydra-v1.2

Thanks everyone — good progress. Quick summary and decisions:

- Approve temporary lock: no fleetwide promotion until compatibility matrix is green and rollback playbook validated.
- Canary plan: start Thu 10/7, 10% capacity, top-k non-critical customers (Marcus to supply list).
- Error handling: soft-reject for >4096 tokens with error code ERR_SEQ_TOO_LONG and telemetry tags: onboarding.hydra.err_seq_too_long, onboarding.hydra.kv_shape_mismatch. Naomi please confirm the exact tag names in the matrix.
- Hydra asked for a 30-minute sync Mon 10/4 3:00pm PT — Marcus and Laura, can you make it?

Next steps (owners):
- Marcus: provision canary + provide top-k list (ETA Mon 10/4 EOD)
- Laura: finalize rollback playbook and confirm KV flush commands (ETA Mon 10/4 morning)
- Kimberly & Naomi: finish the compatibility matrix with telemetry names and perf deltas (ETA Tue 10/5)

Claire — I'll circulate a short note to legal/CS to formalize the canary SLA exception; we'll avoid any fleet promotions without your explicit sign-off.

Attaching current files again: hydra-v1.2-compat-matrix.csv, staging-rollout-plan-v2.docx

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference
